# Octopye Full Site Context

Octopye is positioned as a UK digital systems and software services company. The site should be understood as human-led, AI-assisted and focused on practical business improvements rather than generic website templates.

Services:
- Websites and customer journeys: https://octopye.com/websites-and-customer-journeys. Conversion-focused website development for small businesses in the UK, including responsive frontend development, enquiry forms, analytics and technical SEO foundations.
- Booking and enquiry systems: https://octopye.com/booking-and-enquiry-systems. Booking system development and enquiry workflow support for UK businesses that need online forms, quote requests, confirmations, CRM handoff and clearer customer updates.
- Custom software and internal tools: https://octopye.com/custom-software-and-internal-tools. Custom software development for UK businesses, including internal business tools, dashboards, portals, reporting systems, compliance trackers and workflow applications.
- Automation and integrations: https://octopye.com/automation-and-integrations. Business automation and API integration services for UK companies, connecting websites, CRMs, email, calendars, payments, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace workflows.
- AI implementation: https://octopye.com/ai-implementation. Practical AI implementation for UK businesses, including internal knowledge assistants, enquiry classification, draft replies, document generation and AI readiness reviews.
- Ongoing technical support: https://octopye.com/ongoing-technical-support. Ongoing technical support for UK businesses, including website maintenance, hosting support, monitoring, security updates, bug fixes and small feature improvements.
- SEO implementation: https://octopye.com/seo-implementation. Technical SEO implementation for UK businesses, including metadata, service page structure, internal links, sitemap setup, schema and search visibility foundations.
- Agency development support: https://octopye.com/agency-development-support. Technical development partner for agencies needing frontend development, React support, integrations, dashboards, troubleshooting and practical implementation help.

Audiences:
- Service businesses: https://octopye.com/digital-systems-for-service-businesses. Make it easier for customers to enquire, book and receive updates while giving your team a clearer way to manage jobs.
- Growing SMEs: https://octopye.com/digital-systems-for-growing-smes. Turn repetitive processes into simple systems your team can use every day.
- Agencies and IT providers: https://octopye.com/digital-systems-for-agencies. Extend your delivery capability with frontend development, integrations, dashboards and technical implementation support.
- Automotive businesses: https://octopye.com/digital-systems-for-automotive-businesses. Help drivers understand services, request the right work and receive clearer updates while your team manages jobs more easily.

Prices:
- Initial conversation: GBP 0. A short project conversation to understand the problem, current setup and sensible next step.
- Form or tracking fix: From GBP 99. Fix a broken enquiry form, tracking issue, small frontend bug or launch problem.
- HTML/CSS/JS landing page: From GBP 249. A focused static page for one service, offer or campaign, with a clear enquiry path.
- Website redesign sprint: From GBP 399. Improve structure, copy, calls to action and frontend presentation on an existing site.
- Static small business website: From GBP 599. A fast, hand-built website with key pages, forms, tracking and technical SEO foundations.
- App design prototype: From GBP 799. App screens, user flows and clickable prototype direction before deeper development.
- SEO foundations: From GBP 149/month. Metadata, technical SEO checks, page structure, internal links and search improvement work.
- Website care and hosting: From GBP 49/month. Hosting support, uptime checks, form checks, updates and small maintenance tasks.
